2021.11.28.title: Winner at the 9th National Tsugaru Shamisen Competition in Lake Biwa
2021.11.28.contents: We competed in the group division of the 9th National Tsugaru Shamisen Competition in Lake Biwa and won first place! We performed "Tsugaru Jongara Bushi." We had been practicing with the goal of winning our first title at the Lake Biwa competition, and we are truly happy to have achieved it. Thank you all for your support!

2021.11.23.title: Performed at the Tokyo 2020 1st Anniversary Cultural Event "Culture Stage"
2021.11.23.contents: We performed at "Culture Stage," a cultural event commemorating the first anniversary of the Tokyo 2020 Games! Our set list featured "Tsugaru Jongara Bushi," the piece that won us a competition title, along with other songs. Thank you to everyone who came!

2022.5.3.title: Winner at the 40th Tsugaru Shamisen World Competition
2022.5.3.contents: We competed in Group B of the 40th Tsugaru Shamisen World Competition and won first place! We performed "Tsugaru Jongara Bushi." Thank you all for your support!

2022.5.20.title: Winner at the 26th Tsugaru Shamisen Concours
2022.5.20.contents: We competed in the Silver Lion Award division (10 or fewer players) of the 26th Tsugaru Shamisen Concours and won first place! We performed "Tsugaru Jongara Bushi." Thank you all for your support!

2023.4.1.title: "Tsugaru Jongara Bushi" Video Released
2023.4.1.contents: We have released a video of "Tsugaru Jongara Bushi," the piece that won first place at the 40th Tsugaru Shamisen World Competition. Please take a look!

2023.10.28.title: Official X Account Launched
2023.10.28.contents: We have launched the official X account of Tsudoi! We will share performance news, competition results, and more there. Please follow us!

2023.10.14.title: Performed at the Narita Gen Festival
2023.10.14.contents: We performed at the Narita Gen Festival held at Naritasan in Chiba Prefecture. We played "Tsugaru Jongara Bushi," our competition-winning piece, along with contemporary songs. We were delighted that so many people stopped to listen. Thank you!

2023.11.19.title: Performed at Shimura-Sakashita Elementary School
2023.11.19.contents: We performed at the "Iki-iki Terakoya Cultural Festival" held at Shimura-Sakashita Elementary School in Itabashi, Tokyo, the hometown of our leader Nakahara! Along with folk songs and original pieces, we collaborated with the students' dance performance, and the venue was packed! We were also happy to receive many questions about the Tsugaru shamisen during the Q&A session. Thank you!

2023.11.24.title: Winner at the 11th National Tsugaru Shamisen Competition in Lake Biwa
2023.11.24.contents: We competed in the group division of the 11th National Tsugaru Shamisen Competition in Lake Biwa and won first place! We performed "Tsugaru Yosare Bushi," and the six of us had practiced hard aiming to win with this piece. We are truly happy to have achieved our goal. Thank you all for your support!

2024.3.13.title: "Tsugaru Yosare Bushi" Video Released
2024.3.13.contents: We have released a video of "Tsugaru Yosare Bushi," the piece that won first place in the group division of the 11th National Tsugaru Shamisen Competition in Lake Biwa. Please take a look!

2024.4.7.title: Winner at the 27th Tsugaru Shamisen Concours
2024.4.7.contents: We competed in the 27th Tsugaru Shamisen Concours and won first place! We performed "Tsugaru Jongara Bushi" as a medley moving from the old style to the new style. Arranging the old style, with its distinctive timing, for an ensemble was a big challenge. This is our second consecutive win following last year! Thank you for your support!

2024.9.16.title: Performing at the 30th Narita Gen Festival
2024.9.16.contents:
We will perform at the 30th Narita Gen Festival on Saturday, October 19! This year we will play two stages, each a packed 30 minutes of classic folk songs and original pieces. We hope to see you there!
[Performance times]
13:15-13:45 @ Narita Tourist Pavilion Stage
15:00-15:30 @ Hanazakicho Stage

2024.9.20.title: "Nova" (composed by Kawasaki Manami) Released on YouTube
2024.9.20.contents: We have released "Nova" (composed by Kawasaki Manami), which we performed at last year's Narita Gen Festival, on YouTube! We will also play it as Tsudoi at the 30th Narita Gen Festival on October 19. Please take a look!

2024.10.29.title: Performed at the 30th Narita Gen Festival
2024.10.29.contents: We performed at the 30th Narita Gen Festival! This year we played two stages of original pieces and virtuosic ensemble playing full of the Tsudoi spirit, and we had the honor of closing the show at the Hanazakicho Stage. We were so happy that many people spoke to us after the performance! Thank you for your continued support of Tsudoi!

2024.12.27.title: Performed at Shimura-Sakashita Elementary School
2024.12.27.contents: Following last year, we performed at the "Iki-iki Terakoya Cultural Festival" held at Shimura-Sakashita Elementary School in Itabashi, Tokyo, Nakahara's hometown. Many children grooved along to the music, and we received lots of questions during the Q&A session, making for a fun atmosphere from start to finish! Thank you all very much!

2025.4.6.title: Winner at the 28th Tsugaru Shamisen Concours
2025.4.6.contents: [Breaking news] We won first place in the Ensemble (Silver Lion Award division) at the 28th National Tsugaru Shamisen Concours! Thank you for your support!

2025.9.17.title: Performing at Toshima Music Circle 2025
2025.9.17.contents:
We will perform at Toshima Music Circle 2025 on Saturday, September 20! A packed 30 minutes of classic folk songs and original pieces. We hope to see you there!
[Performance time]
15:30-16:00 @ Minami-Ikebukuro Park  Free admission (tips welcome) *Canceled in case of rain

2025.10.21.title: Performed at the 31st Narita Gen Festival
2025.10.21.contents: We performed at the 31st Narita Gen Festival held on Saturday, October 28! We played two stages of original pieces and virtuosic ensemble playing full of the Tsudoi spirit, and as last year, we had the honor of closing the show at the Hanazakicho Stage. We were so happy that many people spoke to us after the performance! Thank you for your continued support of Tsudoi!

2025.11.24.title: Performed at Shimura-Sakashita Elementary School
2025.11.24.contents: We performed at the "Iki-iki Terakoya Cultural Festival" held at Shimura-Sakashita Elementary School in Itabashi, Tokyo, Nakahara's hometown. We are invited every year, and this was our third appearance. We were truly delighted by the big applause after our performance. Thank you very much to the event staff and to everyone who came early in the morning.

2026.7.9.title: Performing at "An Evening of Rakugo and Shamisen" at Funabori Matsuya Salon on Wed, July 22
2026.7.9.contents:
We will perform at "An Evening of Rakugo and Shamisen" at Funabori Matsuya Salon on Wednesday, July 22.
At this event, you can enjoy rakugo (traditional comic storytelling) and shamisen performances over dinner.

We will present a rich set list ranging from traditional folk songs to contemporary pieces. We hope to see you there!

[Reception]
17:30-18:00 @ Funabori Matsuya Salon *Reservation required

For event details and reservations, please see the official website.

2026.8.6.contents:

2026.10.6.title: Performing at the 32nd Narita Gen Festival on Sat, October 17!
2026.10.6.contents:
We will perform at the 32nd Narita Gen Festival on Saturday, October 17!

We hope to see you there!
